newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA passes on 105,000T of feed wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA passes on 105,000T of feed wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) said on Wednesday it passed on tenders for 105,000 tonnes of feed wheat due to high prices.
An official at the association said its target price for the feed wheat purchase was at around $136 per tonne on a cost and freight (C&F) basis if sourced from Canada.
However, the prices by suppliers were more than $140 a tonne, C&F.
He said the association was considering changing its original plan to buy feed wheat and may substitute the wheat for corn. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5651
